reason: The core verdict is right but not new. 'V_pub = highest display' is +EV now that the ±0.003 noise premise is gone. round20/REPORT.md l.64 already replaced the old rule with 'replace V_pub only at a strictly larger display or UP'. The action line has three errors. (1) It says 'ties go to exp85a'. The pre-registered tie order (CONTEXT l.3181; card v5 order (1)) puts the last attributable UP first. So exp89p/exp89q at an equal 0.958 with '0u' BECOMES V_pub (the same point as scan_hyp_cardfix inconsistency 2). That is the worse curse case, not the +0.001 case. My rounding-aware MC (scratchpad r29/vr_rcb_0u.py, same model as rc_curse.py) gives these E[private - exp85a] for a SEC '0u' tie: -0.05/+0.06/+0.21e-3 (mc26 prior, rho 0.3/0.5/0.8) and -0.26/-0.10/+0.14e-3 (mean -0.5e-3). For SEC at 0.959 it gives +0.12/+0.34/+0.66 and -0.10/+0.17/+0.57. Setting sd to 2.5e-3 for the one-seed spread changes little. (2) At +0.001 the finding's own numbers are +EV in 5 of 6 cells. Showing {exp85a, #37} as a 'near-equal alternative' can only lose EV if the user takes it. It also invites a post-hoc departure from an order written before the reads, which the card forbids ('order written before the reads', no 'recommend'). (3) 'Private keeps ~25-70%' is overstated. The pool output gives 0.068/0.589 = 12% at muS -0.5e-3, rho 0.3, so the range is ~12-73%. Feasibility is fine: text only, no build, no submit, no change to R1-R10 or the morning table. The card is now v5, not v4. As written, the note warns about the milder case and misses the one that gets through by the tie rule.
fix: Keep the rule and all submits unchanged. Do not add the '+0.001 SEC near-equal alternative' line. If a curse line goes on card v5 at all (fill 12:03Z / 18:37Z), make it informational only and aim it at both SEC paths: 'V_pub = highest display is +EV (private keeps ~10-70% of a public step). If V_pub is a SEC file (exp89p/exp89q) that got there only by a tie with an attributable UP (0u, 0.958), its private edge over exp85a is ~0 (-0.26..+0.21e-3). At exactly 0.959 it is small but positive (-0.10..+0.66e-3). The pre-registered order stands.' Also fix the finding's wording 'ties go to exp85a' to 'ties go to the attributable-UP file, then non-CI, fewer levers, earlier submit'.
realistic_gain: ~0 on LB and private. The note changes no file. The event where it matters (a SEC file becomes V_pub by 0u or +0.001) has p ~0.15-0.35, and the private stake inside it is at most ~0.3e-3, which is below the 0.001 display step. The main value is keeping the card from misstating the tie rule.
